name: quantile_regression_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when VWAP deviation, volume surge, and 1-minute momentum all simultaneously reach extreme levels in the same direction, the joint conditional distribution of the next 30-60 second return is so heavily skewed that even the pessimistic 10th quantile is positive. This three-way alignment signals that VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms are actively accumulating (above-VWAP price forces them to buy at benchmark), confirmed by real order flow (1.3x volume surge) and sustained directional commitment (positive 1-min return). Rather than fitting a full quantile regression model, we approximate the QR_P10 > 0 condition by requiring all three predictors to simultaneously hit extreme composite territory — trading only when the full distribution is shifted, not just the mean.

indicators.name: vwap_dist
indicators.purpose: Cumulative VWAP from session open — no scaling needed, this is an anchor reference not a rolling lookback. Measures how far NIFTY has deviated from the institutional benchmark, in bps. VWAP-benchmarked funds face pressure to buy when below VWAP (getting better fills) and to sell when above (getting worse fills), creating a systematic flow bias.

indicators.name: vol_ratio
indicators.purpose: 60 bars = 5 min rolling average volume. Chosen because 5-min captures the current session's volume rhythm without being too sensitive to individual candle spikes (< 2 min) or too slow to detect intraday regime shifts (> 10 min). A ratio > 1.3 confirms institutional participation rather than noise.

indicators.name: ret_12
indicators.purpose: 12 bars = 60 seconds (1 min) return in bps. Compressed from original's 30-min ROC on 1-min bars: we hold 30-60s, so the momentum context should match our hold timescale. A 1-min return detects the immediate directional impulse that has sustained for at least one full minute — enough to distinguish trend from 5-second noise.

indicators.name: composite_score
indicators.purpose: 120 bars = 10 min for normalization. Equal-weight z-score combination of VWAP deviation and 1-min momentum, normalized by recent volatility so that high-volatility regimes don't dominate. Approximates the quantile regression predictor composite — when this score is extreme, the return distribution is shifted.

indicators.name: score_pct_high
indicators.purpose: 240 bars = 20 min rolling percentile. Long enough to have seen multiple signal episodes for stable percentile estimation; short enough to adapt to intraday regime changes. This approximates the QR_P10 > 0 condition: trading only when composite score is in the top (100 - pct_threshold) % of recent scores.

conditions: composite_score > score_pct_high (composite in top tier of 20-min distribution)
vwap_dist > vwap_dist_threshold (NIFTY above VWAP, institutional buy pressure)
vol_ratio > vol_ratio_threshold (volume surge confirms institutional activity)
buy_ce.confirmation: All four conditions must hold simultaneously — this is the quantile-shift condition where the full return distribution is bullish

conditions: composite_score < score_pct_low (composite in bottom tier of 20-min distribution)
vwap_dist < -vwap_dist_threshold (NIFTY below VWAP, institutional sell pressure)
vol_ratio > vol_ratio_threshold (volume surge confirms institutional activity)
buy_pe.confirmation: All four conditions must hold simultaneously — the full return distribution is bearish

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts = ~8 NIFTY spot pts. High-confidence multi-predictor signals should not retrace 8 spot pts within 30-60 seconds if the distribution shift thesis is valid — NIFTY 30s typical range is 2-5 pts, so 4-pt stop allows normal bar noise while exiting when the distribution read was clearly wrong.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option pts = ~12 NIFTY spot pts. When three aligned predictors create a full distribution shift, the expected 1-minute move for NIFTY is 3-7 pts; 6 pts targets the upper half of this range at 1:1.5 R:R. The distribution-shift edge is strongest at the front of the move — capturing 50% of the expected 1-min move before the signal decays.

filters.vix_filter: none — VIX is not used; quantile distribution shift applies across volatility regimes
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:25 IST; skip first 15 min for VWAP and indicator warmup
filters.volume_filter: vol_ratio > vol_ratio_threshold built into entry conditions
filters.trend_filter: ret_12 and vwap_dist provide implicit trend filter
filters.spread_filter: limit orders at close price, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: Medium — composite percentile thresholds adapt to intraday regime, but sustained trending days may generate fewer signals as VWAP divergence grows and distributions shift persistently.

adaptation_notes: Original strategy applied quantile regression on individual NIFTY 50 stocks using a fitted model on 5 days of historical data. Converted to NIFTY index by: (1) applying the same three predictors (VWAP distance, volume ratio, return) to the index itself rather than stocks; (2) replacing the fitted QR model with a rolling composite percentile — this approximates QR_P10 > 0 (trade only when even the worst case is positive) by requiring the composite signal to be in extreme territory; (3) compressing return lookback from 30 min to 1 min since we hold 30-60s not 15-45 min; (4) volume ratio window chosen as 5 min (60 bars) rather than 20-min original because 5s bars at 5-min avg give stable but responsive normalization.
weaknesses: Rolling percentile approximation is coarser than true quantile regression — the original's fitted model captures nonlinear relationships that the composite z-score misses
NIFTY volume is noisier than individual stock volume at 5s, making vol_ratio signals less reliable; the 60-bar average smooths this but extreme individual 5s spikes can trigger false positives
In strong trending sessions, VWAP deviation can grow monotonically and vol_ratio stays elevated all session, increasing false signal frequency — no regime filter to suppress this
